about.description: The Hangout is a family-friendly restaurant and bar serving fresh seafood and cold drinks with free live music nightly in a courtyard setting. They offer an entertainment-focused dining experience with activities for all ages including foam parties, yard games, and themed celebrations.
about.elevator_pitch: A beachfront seafood restaurant and entertainment destination featuring fresh food, live music, foam parties, and family-friendly activities.
about.vibe: Fun, lively, family-friendly beach atmosphere with continuous entertainment, casual dining, and nostalgic decor collections
about.insider_tip: The restaurant features world-famous collection walls including matchbox cars, PEZ dispensers, vintage lunch boxes, and rubber duckies, plus a One Stop Fun Shop for souvenirs
